author: Karl Rock
description:
Would you trust this dentist in Pakistan? I found this tooth-cleaning man selling his wares at Allah Wali Market in Karachi, Pakistan, but would you actually trust a stranger with your teeth?

Street remedies and unverified dental treatments can be dangerous. Using unsterilised tools or unknown substances in your mouth can lead to infections, injury and other serious complications. Never risk your dental health on an unverified street treatment. Always consult a qualified dental professional.

Would you trust him, or would you walk away?
title: Would You Trust Him & His Potion?
